causeCollection.description:
A lower-level set of structured errors.

Only oneOf `causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection` will ever be set.

causeIndexedCollection.description:
A lower-level set of structured errors.
Each of these errors MUST have index set.

Only oneOf `causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection` will ever be set.

causeIsInternal.description: If true, then the cause (`causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection`) should be hidden from the user.

causeSimple.description:
Simple string error type.

Only oneOf `causeWrapped`, `causeSimple`, `causeCollection`, or `causeIndexedCollection` will ever be set.

domain.description:
The "domain" for the error.  If empty, it is an EDA
core error.  Alternatively it can be an EDA application
"apiVersion" value (e.g. interfaces.eda.nokia.com/v1alpha1)
indicating that the error is specific to that application.
The domain gives the receiver information that they can use
to help them interpret the "type" field.

index.description:
When processing an array, errors may be generated related to a particular array item.
If set, this index indicates to which array item the error applies.

message.description: The basic text error message for the error response.

ref.description: Reference to the error source. Should typically be the URI of the request.

type.description:
Type defines a unique identifier for the error, within the domain.
This may be used (along with the domain) to find an internationalization translation for the message.

SHOULD be a valid golang identifier, and SHOULD be in UpperCamelCase.

values.description:
Associated data/information.
The error "message" may contain {{name}} escapes that should be substituted with information from this dictionary.

Note that this map MUST NOT contain JSON objects (`{...}`) or arrays (`[...]`), only simple JSON types are permitted.

ErrorResponse.title: Generic error response for REST APIs.

ack.description: acknowledge or reject the input request

input.description: provide a json blob to the workflow

x-eda-nokia-com.ui-pattern-error: The apiVersion must be set to certchecker.eda.nokia.com/v1alpha1
The kind must be set to NodeCertificateAudit

spec.description: NodeCertificateAuditSpec defines the desired state of NodeCertificateAudit.

nodeSelectors.description: Selects TopoNodes for which certificate audit is to be performed.
nodeSelectors.title: Node Selectors

nodes.description: List of TopoNodes for which certificate audit is to be performed. When left empty, all TopoNodes are selected.
nodes.title: Nodes

spec.title: Specification

status.description: NodeCertificateAuditStatus defines the observed state of NodeCertificateAudit.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the spec generation last fully processed for status.
Populated by the flow engine; not set by the workflow binary.

rpcError.description:
RPCError is set when the workflow fails for infrastructure reasons — dial, target resolution,
or stream failures — before all targets are reported (distinct from per-target Error).

targetResults.description: TargetResults is populated in spec order after streaming from cert-checker.

items.description:
NodeCertificateAuditTargetResult summarizes one streamed audit outcome for a TopoNode target.
TargetType and PodName are omitted: all targets are TopoNodes; PodName is not applicable.

address.description: Address is the dial endpoint used for this target when reported by cert-checker.

certNotAfter.description: CertNotAfter is the certificate not-after bound when reported (e.g. RFC3339).

certNotBefore.description: CertNotBefore is the certificate not-before bound when reported (e.g. RFC3339).

items.description: NodeCertificateAuditChainEntry is one certificate in the served TLS chain (from cert-checker metadata).

error.description: Error is the per-target failure message from cert-checker when Success is false.

subjectAltNames.description: SubjectAltNames lists DNS/IP SANs when reported.

success.description:
Success is nil when the target has not yet been audited; false when the audit failed; true on success.
null in JSON status means pending (intentional: omitempty is not set).

status.title: Status

com.nokia.eda.certchecker.v1alpha1.Platf.description: PlatformCertificateAudit is the Schema for the platformcertificateaudits API

spec.description:
PlatformCertificateAuditSpec defines the desired state of PlatformCertificateAudit.
The spec is intentionally empty: target selection always audits all discoverable
EDA apps in EdaNamespace() (one target per distinct eda.nokia.com/app label value).
spec.title: Specification

status.description: PlatformCertificateAuditStatus defines the observed state of PlatformCertificateAudit.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the spec generation last fully processed for status.
Populated by the flow engine; not set by the workflow binary.

rpcError.description:
RPCError is set when the workflow fails for infrastructure reasons — dial, target resolution,
or stream failures — before all targets are reported (distinct from per-target Error).

targetResults.description: TargetResults is populated after streaming from cert-checker, one entry per audited EDA app.

items.description:
PlatformCertificateAuditTargetResult summarizes one streamed audit outcome for an EDA app target.
TargetType is omitted: all targets are App pods. PodName is retained (set by cert-checker).

address.description: Address is the dial endpoint used for this target when reported by cert-checker.

certNotAfter.description: CertNotAfter is the certificate not-after bound when reported (e.g. RFC3339).

certNotBefore.description: CertNotBefore is the certificate not-before bound when reported (e.g. RFC3339).

items.description: PlatformCertificateAuditChainEntry is one certificate in the served TLS chain.

error.description: Error is the per-target failure message from cert-checker when Success is false.

podName.description: PodName is the resolved pod identity ("namespace/pod") reported by cert-checker.

subjectAltNames.description: SubjectAltNames lists DNS/IP SANs when reported.

success.description:
Success is nil when the target has not yet been audited; false when the audit failed; true on success.
null in JSON status means pending (intentional: omitempty is not set).

status.title: Status
